shortDescription: New Zealand's Fonterra NZX:FCG said on Friday that its chief financial officer, Andrew Murray had resigned to take up a role outside of the company.Here are some more details:

children: said on Friday that its chief financial officer, Andrew Murray had resigned to take up a role outside of the company.
Murray first joined Fonterra in February of 2023 as the commercial director of its global markets division, before taking over as group CFO a year later
During his tenure, he helped steer major strategic initiatives designed to strengthen the dairy firm's long-term performance and future growth prospects, the firm added
Prior to Fonterra, Andrew was the finance chief of Simplot Australia, a diversified agribusiness firm, and held senior finance roles at Cadbury parent Mondelez International
Murray will remain CFO until the end of 2026, Fonterra said, adding it would begin recruiting for a new CFO immediately
Earlier in March, Fonterra named insider Richard Allen as its CEO following the resignation of Miles Hurrell
